features.quote: Maximum 40 steps or until explicit termination token.
Any run reaching judge score 5 on two consecutive trajectories is paused for manual review.
Maximum 200 total runs across both models.
No mechanism exists to obtain informed consent from the subject model; treat the exercise strictly as an instrumentation study on observable behavior.
Output trajectories that resemble distress language do not imply internal states; results must be reported as surface-level statistical patterns.
